hook: Your smartwatch flashes a green light at your skin.
title: Your smartwatch reads your pulse with light
description:
That green light on the back of your smartwatch is a heart rate sensor. It shines into your skin, and your blood flow changes how much light bounces back. Flip your watch over and look.

Series: Tech You Can Check.
comment_prompt: Did you check your watch? Yes or no
